title: Distinguish active-two extremal effects from the extra vacuum reference dimension
statement: In the subunit positive rational 3x3 problem, real active dimension at most two suffices for a free extremal witness in closure; expansive vertices are scalar. The inherited active/vacuum construction uses an additional reference dimension to approach the conditional-Umegaki supremum. This does not assert attainment by a finite faithful state pair or physical preparation.

body: For a two-component vector w let U have its columns, G=U*U and E_i=U*Q_i U. Projection gives ||X*w||²>=d*G+ d, d=sum_i E_i x_i. Equality is realizable on rank G<=2 by support-restricted inverse square roots; conjugate averaging makes real data sufficient. The normalized moment SDP and common-center dual then preserve the exact coefficient. Saved rational unnormalized E_i,h_i encode Q_i=G^-1/2 E_i G^-1/2 and u_i=G^-1/2 h_i, while the ratio is evaluated exactly without a rational square root. Strict channel positivity supports faithful limits; it does not eliminate the vacuum lift or its logarithmic convergence costs.
